title: An Analysis of Carbon-Reduction Pledges of U.S. Oil and Gas Companies
authors: Hemang Desai; Pauline Lam; Bin Li; Shiva Rajgopal
eligible_reason: No staggered panel DiD in the package. Table 3 is a cross-sectional logit of pledge determinants (cut_dum on production, CROCI, BlackRock ownership, EPA cases, Engine No. 1). Tables 4-5 are short-window announcement-return regressions: reg/areg aret 1.pledgeannc##1.netzero plus time-varying controls (log_mktcap_l1, earn_ann, log_epa_cases, engine1), with firm-by-pledge-date FE (firmxdate) in the even columns. The pledge-announcement indicator marks event days in a stacked event-window sample, not a binary treatment switching on in calendar time with unit and calendar-time FE. The 'difference-in-differences' term refers to the pledgeannc x netzero contrast in these event-window regressions.
design_notes: sample_determinants.dta: firm-level cross-section of U.S. oil and gas firms. sample_event_study.dta: firm x day observations around emission-cut and net-zero pledge announcements; aret = abnormal return; pledgeannc = announcement window indicator; netzero = pledge type; firmxdate = firm x pledge-date group. Built from Compustat/CRSP/ISS/EPA data via Sample_creation_MS.sas.
estimators_reported: event-window abnormal-return regressions with firm x event FE

specs.exclusion_reason: event-window (stacked) announcement-return regression with firm x event FE and time-varying controls; not a calendar-time staggered DiD
specs.notes: Table 5 panels A-C split netzero by pledge quality.

priority_note: Not eligible: cross-sectional logit and event-window return regressions.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (readme.txt, Stata_codes_MS.do in full, SAS code grep). No article text available.
